d: China and Nigeria are deepening maritime cooperation as Beijing looks to expand its strategic footprint in the Gulf of Guinea. Nigeria's maritime agency, NIMASA, has signed a Memorandum of Understanding with China's Maritime Safety Administration to strengthen cooperation in maritime security, navigation, training and technical development. But what does Beijing stand to gain from this partnership? With growing military and economic engagement across West Africa, China is seeking to strengthen its influence in a strategically important, resource-rich region. Alyson Le Grange examines what…
